# refactor

Replaces old primitives with a candidate, measuring whether the basis actually improved. Superseded nodes are retained with provenance.

**Flow:** RefactorProposal → SemanticLearner.accept_refactor (measures improvement) → new basis + Store.save.
**Human gate:** minimum_improvement threshold; proposal was generated by propose_refactor.
**Does not hit:** accept_candidate (separate lifecycle).
